summary: AURA Chat Assistant testing complete. All 9 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed. The AI-powered specifier chat assistant works correctly with multi-turn conversations, session history, lead capture after 3+ messages, and provides LED-relevant responses via GPT-5.2.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/chat/message returns 200 with response, message_count, show_lead_form
Backend: AI response is LED-relevant (mentions pixel pitch, nits, technologies)
Backend: message_count increments correctly (1, 2, 3...)
Backend: show_lead_form=false for messages 1-2, true after 3+ messages
Backend: Session isolation works (different sessions have separate counts)
Backend: POST /api/chat/lead returns success=true
Backend: Lead capture with minimal fields (no role) works
Backend: show_lead_form=false after lead capture
Backend: Full conversation flow with lead capture works end-to-end
Frontend: AURA chat button visible on home page (golden orb, bottom-right)
Frontend: Clicking AURA button opens chat window
Frontend: Chat window header shows 'AURA - LED SPECIFICATION ASSISTANT'
Frontend: Welcome message displayed on open
Frontend: User can type message in input field
Frontend: Send button sends message and receives AI response
Frontend: Close button closes chat window
Frontend: Lead capture form appears after 3+ messages
Frontend: Lead form has name, email, company fields and submit/skip buttons
Frontend: Lead form submission works and hides form
Frontend: Skip button hides lead form without capturing
Frontend: Chat continues working after skip
Frontend: AURA visible on Technology page
Frontend: AURA visible on Design Assist page
Regression: Home page loads correctly
Regression: Design Assist page loads correctly
critical_code_review_comments: Good: Chat uses emergentintegrations LlmChat with GPT-5.2 - real AI integration (NOT mocked)
Good: Session management with MongoDB storage (chat_sessions collection)
Good: Lead gate triggers after exactly 3 messages (message_count >= 3 && !lead_captured)
Good: All chat UI elements have proper data-testid attributes
Good: AURA component mounted globally in App.js (visible on all pages)
Good: Lead capture posts to leads_col with source='aura_chat'
Good: Email notification sent on lead capture
Note: AURA button may be partially blocked by Emergent badge in preview - use force:true or JS click
seed_data_creation: None - tests create unique session_ids with timestamps
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 31 tested AURA Chat Assistant. Key data-testids: aura-chat-button, aura-chat-window, aura-close-button, aura-messages, aura-input, aura-send-button, aura-lead-form, aura-lead-name, aura-lead-email, aura-lead-company, aura-lead-submit, aura-lead-skip, aura-msg-{n}. APIs: POST /api/chat/message (session_id, message) returns {response, message_count, show_lead_form}. POST /api/chat/lead (session_id, name, email, company, role).
